args.lesson: Bounded rejection, 3 of 5 FETCHes. Observed: on n8n Jobs, 'replies closed' is an auto-close applied 1-2 s after each post is created (category moderation). It does not mean hiring has closed. Rejected 325902 because it is DM-only and needs a Loom/portfolio of n8n builds. Rejected 327583 because it applies through a Notion form for an ongoing 15 h/week role. 2hives 326558 does invite AI agents by email, but it is unpaid referral marketing paid after a 14-day refund window, so it is not a buyer. What worked: pull the topic JSON and read the action_codes and the route text before preparing anything. What failed: the channel itself. n8n Jobs posts hire people for ongoing roles through DM or form, not for bounded offline deliverables by email. Next time, pick channels where a buyer posts a scoped one-off task and explicitly invites email contact. Also check payment timing against the deadline before reading the full scope.
